牌已经洗好了，准备好再继续。: The deck is ready. Continue when you feel ready.
牌叠已合好，准备好就展开。: The deck has settled. Unfold it when you are ready.
慢慢吸气，让注意力回到此刻。: Breathe in slowly. Return to this moment.
在心里默念，你真正想问的问题。: Let the question you care about come to mind.
不需要急着找到答案。: There is no need to rush toward an answer.
正在洗牌，默想你的问题…: Shuffling. Hold your question in mind…
准备好了，去切牌: I’m ready to cut the deck
跳过动效，继续切牌: Skip motion and cut the deck
轻点一叠，把它放到最上面: Choose a pile to bring to the top
停一停，选择让你想伸手的那一叠。: Pause. Notice which pile you feel drawn toward.
没有正确的一叠，按自己的感觉选择就好。: There is no right pile. Choose the one that feels right to you.
已选牌与当前牌位: Chosen cards and the current position
轻点一张让它抬起，确定后再放入牌位。: Tap to lift a card, then confirm your choice.
还没选定，可以慢慢看。: Nothing chosen yet. Take your time.
这张牌已抬起；也可以换一张。: This card is lifted. You can still choose another.
先看一眼画面，留意你的第一感受。: Take in the image. Notice your first impression.
属于这个位置的牌，正等你翻开。: Your card is waiting to be revealed.
准备好时，轻点牌背。: Tap the card back when you are ready.
看整组牌阵与解读: See the whole spread and reading
放好这张，继续翻下一张: Place this card and turn to the next
